tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// mi g.yo ba'i 'khor lo bzhugs// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ a tsa la tsakra/ bod skad du/ mi g.yo ba'i 'khor lo// gtum po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// sor bzhi pa'i 'phar ma'i dbus su ral gri'i phreng ba bri bar bya ste/ de'i dbus su/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ka ra s+ya/ rak+ṣaṃ shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ tro ṭi ku ru hūm̐ swā hā/ de'i phyi rol tu/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ aṃ a tsa le tseṭ+ṭa badz+rā ṇāṃ/ aṃ a tsa le tseṭ+ṭa ka na/ naṭ+ṭa naṭ+ṭa/ paṭ+ṭa paṭ+ṭa/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ mo ha mo ha/ sa ha sa ha/ madha rā ṭa/ gardzadza gardzadza/ ha na ha na/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ a be sha ya/ ma hā ma gra ba la ka dhu na dhu na/ ṭi ni ṭi ni/ la da la da/ bigh+nā na/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ duṣ+ṭān bhak+ṣa ya/ sarbaṃ ku ru/ ki ri ki ri/ ma hā bi sha badz+re/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ aṃ aṃ aṃ/ haṃ haṃ haṃ/ a tsa la tse ta/ s+pho ṭa ya/ s+pho ṭa ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ a sa ma ni ta ka rā ṭa/ ma hā pa la sha tā ya/ tseṭ+ṭa ya/ pa ra man+t+ra na/ aṃ haṃ aṃ shu/ dh+yai tu lo ka duṣ+ṭā tu/ badz+ri a pra ti ba le/ bho na mi tu dz+wa ya tra ta a swā hā/ na mo dha ra ka s+ye/ rak+ṣaṃ shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ dhi tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ra ka s+ye/ i na t+ya/ bi d+yā la traṃ ts+tshe da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ de'i phyi rol tu sor phyed pa'i 'phar ma la/ oṃ a tsa le tseṭ+ṭa s+pho ṭa ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dak+ṣi shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ dhiṃ taṃ ku ru swā hā/ trai lo kya s+ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de'i phyi rol tu sor gsum pa'i dbus su/ re kha gnyis pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bri bar bya ste/ de'i phyogs kyi 'dab ma rnams su ral gri/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma'i nang du/ rdo rje zhags pa gnyis kyi dbus su/ hūm̐ gnyis phyogs rnams kyi re kha gnyis kyi bar du/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ra ka s+ye/ i na t+ya bi d+yā la traṃ ts+tshe da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ra ka s+ye/

da madz+dza ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ra ka s+ye/ man+sa ragho ra ṭa/ bi sa ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ra ka s+ye/ pri du la du kha la traṃ ts+tshe da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ mtshams rnams su/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ra ka s+ye/ sarba duṣ+ṭān dz+wā lā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ra ka s+ye/ sarba smai nai rad+mi ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ra ka s+ye/ me sarba bha mā nāṃ sha tā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ra ka s+ye/ ma hā ṇi dz+dzā nāṃ par+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ de'i phyi rol tu sor phyed pa'i 'phar ma'i dbus su thug par byas la/ hūm̐ gi phreng ba bri bar bya'o// de'i phyi rol tu re kha gnyis dang 'brel pa'i sor phyed pa'i 'phar ma'i bar du/ oṃ a tsa laṃ tseṭ+ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kā ma nā da hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā man+dha pa la kā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bigh+nān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ma yān+dha na ba ta sa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bi shwa badz+ra s+pho ṭa ya bha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tri pa li ti la raṃ ka na rta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sa man+ti ka ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ma la sha tā ya sarba bigh+nān/ bi nā ya ka d+ya bya da/ oṃ dha ra ka s+ye/ rak+ṣaṃ/ di kaṃ kur wan+tu phaṭa swā hā/ de'i phyi rol tu sor phyed pa'i 'phar ma'i dbus su ri mo gsum pa/ nyi shu rtsa bzhis bskor ba bri bar bya'o// de'i phyi rol tu 'od zer bri bar bya'o// mi g.yo ba'i 'khor lo rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chos kyi rdo rje dang*/ lo tsā ba dge tshul nam mkha'i rdo rjes bsgyur ba'o// //sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs gtso bo'i// rtog med ye shes dpa' bo che// gnyis med rdo rje mnyam 'jug las// khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la bstod// sdug bsngal skyes dngos legs rtogs la// yang dag lta ba skyed mdzad cing*// gtum chen mi bzad 'jigs gzugs can// sreg byed tshar gcod khro la bstod// shes rab ral gri 'od 'bar bas// nyon mongs rtsad nas gcod mdzad cing*// lha dang lha min sogs 'jigs mdzad// 'ching ba gcod la phyag 'tshal bstod// thabs mkhas thugs rje gsang ba'i bdag

/srid mtshor 'khyams pa'i sems can rnams// bla med gnas su 'dren mdzad cing*// 'gro ba 'dren la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'od zer nyi ma 'bum pas lhag /'jig dus bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// rab 'khrugs 'ur chen skad 'byin pa// nyon mongs gcod la phyag 'tshal bstod// mi g.yo zhes bya'i khro bo ni// ral gri zhags pa legs par bsnams// spyi bo'i zur phud g.yon du 'phyang*// rang gi dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa// klu chen la sogs thams cad pa// rgyan rnams kun gyis rab tu brgyan// byis pa'i gzugs can phreng ba can// rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan nang nas thugs rje'i rang bzhin las// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro tshul ston mdzad cing*// chos nyid mi 'gyur sku mdog mthing nag sngo// bcom ldan mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rgyud nas 'byung ba rdzogs so// ༄// oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+rī bha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa a// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
